t: You're looking at The Last Faust, described as a Gesamtkunstwerk, an art project on Goethe's Faust. It was made by Philipp Humm, who was born in 1959. Humm is an artist and film director, and before that he was a European business executive. The project takes Goethe's Faust as its starting point, and it's meant to be taken as a total work of art, not just a single object. I can't say much more about it from what's known, so take your time and see what it says to you.
